title: BlastRecord
description: Contract 1 (ingestion), catalog row blast-record 1.0.0: one row of the published corpus as data-pipeline/pipeline/io/contract.py validate_row accepts it. The seven feature ranges are the contract bounds of the engine (blastfrag.datasets.CONTRACT_BOUNDS): outside them the row is rejected, never clipped. Extra columns are allowed because validate_row ignores them (the corpus rows carry a meta mapping); the required columns are exactly REQUIRED_COLUMNS.

site.description: The campaign the row belongs to.

S_over_B.description: spacing / burden; outside [0.5, 3.0] is a rejection, not an unusual blast.

H_over_B.description: bench height / burden; outside [0.5, 15.0] is a rejection, not an unusual blast.

B_over_D.description: burden / hole diameter; outside [5.0, 80.0] is a rejection, not an unusual blast.

T_over_B.description: stemming / burden; outside [0.1, 8.0] is a rejection, not an unusual blast.

Pf_kg_m3.description: powder factor, kg/m3; outside [0.05, 3.0] is a rejection, not an unusual blast.

XB_m.description: in situ block size, m; outside [0.005, 10.0] is a rejection, not an unusual blast.

E_GPa.description: Young modulus, GPa; outside [0.5, 150.0] is a rejection, not an unusual blast.

x50_m.description: The measured mean fragment size in metres; absent or null for a design that was never measured.

group.description: The rock-stiffness group of the published two-group split; null when no arm assigned one.
